name: HVAC & Refrigeration
summary: Heating, ventilating, air-conditioning and refrigeration of buildings and processes: loads, psychrometrics, equipment, distribution and controls.

topics.name: Thermal comfort and indoor air quality (ASHRAE 55 and 62.1)
Psychrometric analysis of HVAC processes, including altitude effects
Air distribution: air handlers, duct design, terminal units and diffusers
Hydronic systems: piping, pumps and balancing
Vapour-compression refrigeration components: compressors, condensers, evaporators, expansion devices
Refrigerants: properties, environmental impact (GWP/ODP) and regulations
Chillers, cooling towers and heat rejection
Heat pumps (air-, water- and ground-source) and VRF systems
Energy recovery ventilation: enthalpy wheels, heat pipes, run-around loops
HVAC controls: economisers, reset strategies and building automation
Commercial and industrial refrigeration, cold storage, freezing and cryogenics overview
Building energy modeling and energy codes (ASHRAE 90.1)
